source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved AMD CPU Configuration values persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default without unexpected topology, virtualization, frequency, power, thermal, boot or OS changes.
original_method: Change CPU Configuration fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while checking logs and normal reboot behavior.
manual_activity: A human must navigate CPU Configuration, change the approved fields, execute both save/reboot phases, select Load Default and inspect firmware values. Automated CPU telemetry is supporting evidence only.
required_inputs: CPU family/stepping, board and BIOS identity
Named CPU fields with baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values
Expected logical CPU, SMT, virtualization, frequency, power and thermal state
Idle host/workload disposition and OS topology baseline
Console/operator, stable power and OOB/vendor recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random; approve every CPU field/value.
Do not change voltage, frequency, power limit, core-enable or virtualization controls without explicit impact and limit review.
Remove or quiesce active workloads according to the approved plan before topology/performance changes.
Stop on thermal/power alarm, missing CPUs, topology mismatch, hang, crash, boot or management loss.
Restore the approved final CPU profile.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only CPU/topology/SMT/virtualization/frequency/power/thermal, OS and BMC evidence.
Compare firmware captures and host state against the approved CPU matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, choose performance limits, start unapproved stress or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve the revision-correct CPU matrix, workload plan, limits and recovery.
Perform/capture non-default persistence and default-restoration phases.
Evaluate CPU/platform evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects BIOS automation. No source command exists; read-only OS/BMC CPU telemetry can support but not replace the firmware observations.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the manual CPU Configuration workflow and add platform-approved read-only topology, virtualization and thermal/power snapshots; do not substitute OS governors, hypervisor controls or register writes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source AMD two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source text but is bounded for execution.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved BIOS field to expected logical CPU/topology, virtualization, frequency/power/thermal state and abort limits; capture BIOS and read-only host/BMC state through persistence, default restoration and final-profile phases.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact AMD CPU/board/BIOS and installed OS/hypervisor.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record CPU family/stepping, board revision, BIOS/vendor firmware, BMC, OS/hypervisor and telemetry versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CPU Configuration specification and platform power/thermal/virtualization limits.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds host-state causality, workload isolation and safety thresholds while retaining both source transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction for the approved field matrix; it does not imply performance benchmarking unless separately approved.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/default/effect matrix, workload disposition and recovery limits.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Observed frequency varies dynamically; it must not be used as exact proof of a firmware value without the platform-defined interpretation.

project_override_considerations: The project may select a safe CPU field subset and optional observation duration. Completion applies only to that matrix and must not be reported as all CPU controls or performance qualification.
expected_evidence: Platform/CPU/firmware identity, approval, idle-state and recovery readiness
First save/reboot persistence and CPU/topology/virtualization/thermal evidence
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and normal-boot evidence
Final CPU profile, host/BMC health, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and SPEC-default restoration. Missing fields and effects are readiness gaps, not opposing source requirements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The CPU-settings purpose is clear. Platform-specific inputs and safety limits gate execution but do not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual classification and adds CPU-specific topology, virtualization and operational safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its CPU field matrix, health evidence and recovery controls while applying V3.1 readiness semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates configuration validation from optional stress/performance coverage and formal verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents random CPU settings from disrupting workloads or exceeding platform limits and ties each firmware control to observable topology or health evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Firmware UI manipulation and visual value validation are core, so MANUAL ONLY applies. CPU telemetry can corroborate downstream state but cannot establish that the BIOS controls persisted/restored correctly by itself.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat CPU setting changes, reboot or default load after any topology, thermal, power, boot or evidence anomaly; preserve the first state and obtain engineer disposition.
